description: This file contains utility functions for selector matching, including attribute matching, text extraction, and label retrieval, used within the Playwright testing framework.

methods.name: matchesComponentAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an object matches a component attribute selector based on JSON path and attribute conditions.

methods.name: matchesAttributePart
methods.description: Determines if a value matches a specific attribute selector condition, supporting various operators.

methods.name: shouldSkipForTextMatching
methods.description: Decides whether an element should be skipped during text matching, such as script or style tags.

methods.name: elementText
methods.description: Extracts and caches the full, normalized, and immediate text content of an element or shadow root.

methods.name: elementMatchesText
methods.description: Checks if an element or its children match a given text matcher, considering shadow DOM.

methods.name: getElementLabels
methods.description: Retrieves accessible labels for an element via ARIA attributes or associated label elements.
